name: type:bug
description: Something shipped does not behave as its spec says

name: type:feature
description: New or changed behaviour of a shipped skill or agent

name: type:task
description: Harness, tooling, documentation, or maintenance work

name: area:agents
description: Client agent files and the agent catalog

name: area:docs
description: docs/ and the Zensical documentation site

name: spec:pending
description: Unarchived OpenSpec change awaiting the maintainer's approval (set by pr-labels)

name: spec:approved
description: Maintainer approved the OpenSpec change at the recorded commit; kept while unchanged

name: spec:archived
description: The OpenSpec change is archived; the pull request may merge (set by pr-labels)

name: spec:skipped
description: Nothing to approve: no change touched, or every change sets skip_specs: true (pr-labels)
